subject: ugc
caption:
Batch the week before you touch the camera.

Six lines, one setup, one afternoon. The schedule is the energy.

slides.headline: Batch the week before the camera.
slides.body: Energy is a schedule, not a mood.

slides.headline: Six slots. One afternoon.
slides.body: Hook, proof, offer, proof, story, close.

slides.headline: Write the line before you roll.
slides.body: The hour dies when you choose lines on camera. Write six first. Record them in order.

slides.headline: Same setup, six lines.
slides.body:
Light stays where it is
Clothes stay as they are
You only change the line
You stop when six are done

slides.headline: Stop filming openings you will cut.
Put six lines on a card.
slides.body: Post them like you mean it.
